name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that skips the generic filler and delivers polished, on-brand slides.
problem: Creating professional presentations is time-consuming, and most AI slide tools produce generic, low-quality content that requires heavy editing. Chronicle 2.0 aims to close the gap between AI speed and human-quality design, letting teams produce compelling decks without the usual AI slop. This is especially valuable for professionals who need to communicate ideas clearly without hiring designers or spending hours in PowerPoint.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with clean, structured narratives
Creating client-facing sales presentations that look professionally designed
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks quickly for leadership reviews
Turning research or reports into polished visual presentations
